what: The FOSSIL_WORLD registry (Amendment 2 R21/R22). One entry per preserved world: its Dockerfile, the verbs it supports (R22) with HOW each is done, and the class of machinery. Measurement-based identity (FOSSIL_WORLD_ID) is computed per packet from Dockerfile sha256 + dpkg manifest sha256 + toolchain probes (techne/fossils/packet.py); this file holds the parts that do not change per build. Image digests live in WORLD_IMAGES*.json (witnesses). A verb is 'yes' only if a committed receipt or test exercises it; 'partial' names the limit; 'no' is a statement.

prometheus-fossil-c:bookworm.how: harvest run: disposable copy (INSTANTIATE), recipe commands (EXECUTE), stdout/stderr/exit + produced-file hashes (OBSERVE, EXTRACT_OUTPUT), $HARNESS files (INJECT_INPUT); INTERVENE partial = patches/flags on the disposable copy; TRACE partial = strace/ltrace not installed

prometheus-fossil-lang:bookworm.how: as fossil-c; guile/sbcl REPLs could give STEP/EXAMINE for Scheme/Lisp bodies but no receipt exercises them

prometheus-fossil-hw:bookworm.how: iverilog/verilator: VCD waveform dumps (TRACE yes), testbench stimulus (INJECT_INPUT, INTERVENE via testbench edits on the copy); STEP/EXAMINE/WATCH partial = per-cycle via testbench $display, not interactive

prometheus-fossil-octave:bookworm.how: octave scripts; harness stubs shadow plotting (INTERVENE yes at the harness level); STEP/EXAMINE partial = octave's debugger exists, no receipt uses it

prometheus-fossil-goexplore:min.how: python 3.7 imports; the Atari/MuJoCo halves are excluded

prometheus-fossil-simh:bookworm.how: open-simh vax780: step/examine/deposit/break (STEP, EXAMINE, WATCH, INTERVENE), disk/tape images (INJECT_INPUT/EXTRACT_OUTPUT), expect scripts for the console; SNAPSHOT/RESTORE partial = simh SAVE/RESTORE exist, no receipt exercises them

prometheus-fossil-pdp1:bookworm.how: open-simh pdp1 headless + macro1: step/examine/deposit (receipt run-spacewar-pdp1-1962-20260916T150305Z); no display; SNAPSHOT/RESTORE not exercised

prometheus-fossil-pdp1:display.how: as pdp1:bookworm + SDL2 Type 30 under xvfb: SCREENSHOT yes (receipt run-spacewar-pdp1-1962-20260916T151039Z, frames under behaviour/)

prometheus-fossil-ibm709x:bookworm.how: s709 console: ss/sc (STEP), ds/es (EXAMINE/INTERVENE), b/w (WATCH), tf trace file (TRACE), D memory dump (SNAPSHOT partial, no restore); card/tape units in, printer/punch BCD out decoded by bcd2txt; asm7090 with the memmove world patch
